data.evidence_sentence: Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a minimum GPA of 3.0/4.0 (75%+).
data.notes: Page is a third-party aggregator (chinascholerships.org) with promotional and inconsistent text: the page describes CSC Type B, USTC Fellowship Level A/B, ANSO and Anhui provincial awards together, so criteria may not apply to every award; the named award is a general USTC scholarship page. Deadline stated as October 16 to January 31 for the autumn intake, so the annual deadline is given as 01-31. Stipend and funding amounts vary (3,000-7,000 RMB) and differ by award and level. Age limits and GPA are stated as strict but apply to the whole page. Preference for applicants with a supervisor contact is not a requirement and is not recorded as such. Page text contradicts itself on Level A/B funding and on whether the 1-year Chinese preparatory course is a degree; the Bachelor's age limit of 25 is the page's own figure. Enrollment status 'applicant' is inferred from the admissions process. Gender, residence and language requirements are not otherwise stated. Degree level 'other' is not included since the Chinese language preparatory year is not the funded level. The ANSO scholarship description mentions developing-nation applicants, which is not a stated requirement for the general page. The 'non-Chinese citizens' phrase is used as the nationality rule.
